- [--fields](/docs/cli/fields): Build schemas on the fly from the CLI using a concise field definition string.

- [Installation & Setup](/docs/cli/installation): Install and configure Struktur.
- [parse](/docs/cli/parse): Convert files to Artifact JSON for inspection or pre-processing.

- [verify](/docs/cli/verify): Validate artifact JSON format.
- [Enrich Records from URLs](/docs/examples/enrich-records): Fetch URLs and extract structured data to enrich existing records.
- [Extract Invoice Data](/docs/examples/extract-invoice): Extract structured invoice data from PDF or text files.
- [Extract Real Estate Listings](/docs/examples/extract-realestate): Extract property data from PDF real estate exposés.

- [Shell Pipelines & Patterns](/docs/examples/pipelines): Practical patterns for using Struktur in shell workflows.
- [Process a Directory of Files](/docs/examples/process-directory): Batch processing with shell pipelines or scripts.
- [Watch a Folder for New Files](/docs/examples/watch-folder): Process files as they arrive in a folder.

- [Explanation](/docs/explanation): undefined
- [Parsers](/docs/explanation/parsers): How Struktur converts files into Artifacts before extraction.

- [Built-in Input Types](/docs/explanation/preprocessing/built-in-inputs): All the ways to get input into Struktur without building a custom provider.

- [Document Processing](/docs/explanation/preprocessing): undefined
- [Choosing a Strategy](/docs/explanation/strategies/choosing): Decision guide for selecting the right extraction strategy.
- [Writing a Custom Strategy](/docs/explanation/strategies/custom-strategy): How to implement your own extraction strategy.
- [doublePassAutoMerge](/docs/explanation/strategies/double-pass-auto-merge): Double-pass extraction with schema-aware merge and deduplication.
- [doublePass](/docs/explanation/strategies/double-pass): Parallel pass for speed, sequential pass for refinement.
- [Struktur](/docs/explanation/strategies): The design philosophy, trade-offs, and extraction strategies behind Struktur.
- [parallelAutoMerge](/docs/explanation/strategies/parallel-auto-merge): Parallel extraction with schema-aware merge and deduplication.
- [parallel](/docs/explanation/strategies/parallel): Concurrent batch processing with LLM merge.
- [sequentialAutoMerge](/docs/explanation/strategies/sequential-auto-merge): Sequential extraction with schema-aware merge and deduplication.
- [sequential](/docs/explanation/strategies/sequential): Process chunks in order with context preservation.
- [simple](/docs/explanation/strategies/simple): Single-shot extraction for small inputs.
- [Validation & Retries](/docs/explanation/validation): How the schema validation loop works and why it matters.
- [What is Struktur?](/docs): Struktur is a structured data extraction engine that turns pre-parsed documents into validated JSON using LLMs.
- [Quickstart](/docs/quickstart): Get started with Struktur in under 5 minutes. Extract structured data from any file.
- [Artifact Helpers](/docs/sdk/artifact-helpers): Functions to create artifacts from various sources.
- [Events & Observability](/docs/sdk/events): Event handlers for progress tracking and observability.
- [extract()](/docs/sdk/extract): Main extraction function for the TypeScript SDK.
- [Fields Shorthand](/docs/sdk/fields): Build JSON schemas on the fly with a simple comma-separated string instead of writing full JSON Schema objects.
